criteria.requirement: The primary requested deliverable is implemented
criteria.passCondition: Evidence demonstrates the complete primary behavior
criteria.failureCondition: Primary behavior is missing or contradicted

criteria.requirement: Mandatory validation and failure states are covered
criteria.passCondition: Required edge and failure states are evidenced
criteria.failureCondition: Mandatory edge or failure states are absent

criteria.requirement: The delivery does not introduce unsafe or unrelated changes
criteria.passCondition: No unsafe or unrelated change is evidenced
criteria.failureCondition: Evidence contains unsafe or unrelated changes
